1) THE DESIGN DECISION (run 0048, task ajcr-w4-rep-free). It is now proved in Lean (commits
49866bdd1, 206967379, 40f357de8; memory I-0327; informal/spec-dd-r.md ADDENDUM 2) that the DD-R
certificate interface `DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified` is satisfiable for a CONNECTED divisor only
if that divisor lies inside a single pinned chart of pi — i.e. avoids pi^{-1}(0) or pi^{-1}(infinity).
The per-piece no-leak clause forces the two chart traces to be closed, cover refinement provably
cannot help, and base localization cannot help either because it does not disconnect the divisor.

The consequence needs a decision that an agent should not take alone:
 (a) if the DD-R chart Z(diamond) already confines its divisors — which spec-dd-r.md ADDENDUM 1
     item 2 asserts but never proves — the remaining certificate work is bookkeeping and the lane
     closes;
 (b) if it does not, then either the atlas gains the avoidance as a carve (an open condition, so
     legitimate), or `IsCertified` / `DivFamZar` must be REDESIGNED — because a functor that cannot
     see chart-crossing divisors is not the relative-divisor functor, and `divRep` stated against it
     would represent the wrong object.
Roadmap leaf AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate.chart-avoid holds this question.

Separately, the task as named ("close representability of Pic^0") is not one lane: the certificate
is one of SIX independent mountains before Challenge.lean:99. dat-g has no spec, no worksheet and no
Lean file; dat-c's `chartLocus` has zero definitions tree-wide though four roadmap comments call the
remainder "plumbing, no math left"; DivRepAffinePullback and DivRepGlobalData have zero producers.
The blueprint states none of this: its only representability node is conditional on a chart family
no node produces, so a blueprint reader concludes representability is done. Consider commissioning
the five missing blueprint nodes before more proving rounds.

2) THE HARNESS PROBLEM. Run 0047 rounds 1-5 (sessions 0004, 0006, 0008, 0010, 0012 of that run)

R2 (generalize the piece type) remain.
